hints.title: Reverse Inorder Cumulative Sum
hints.text: Every node must be updated with the sum of all keys greater than or equal to its original value.

hints.title: Right-to-Left Inorder Traversal
hints.text: Traversing right child first, then root, then left child visits keys in descending order.

hints.title: Accumulator Propagation
hints.text: Maintain running total = 0. In reverse inorder traversal: recurse right, add node value to total, update node.val = total, and recurse left.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import Optional

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

class Solution:
    def convertBST(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        total = 0

        def reverse_inorder(node: Optional[TreeNode]):
            nonlocal total
            if not node:
                return
            reverse_inorder(node.right)
            total += node.val
            node.val = total
            reverse_inorder(node.left)

        reverse_inorder(root)
        return root
```

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Single pass reverse inorder traversal updating values in-place.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all nodes for each node takes O(N^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Descending order traversal updates values directly without auxiliary arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use reverse inorder traversal (Right-Root-Left) with running accumulator.
